title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: percentage, money limit and rounding of demurrage goodwill
content:
## Scope

Under the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category, this rule turns the goodwill base of a demurrage invoice line into the goodwill granted, using the goodwill limits of the product on the per-container record.

## Rule

1. The goodwill granted on a demurrage line is the product's goodwill percentage limit applied to the goodwill base, never more than the product's goodwill money limit.
2. The figure is rounded down to the cent only at the end.
3. Products whose goodwill percentage limit is 0 give no goodwill.

## Order of working

1. Multiply the goodwill base by the percentage limit and divide by 100.
2. Where that figure is above the money limit, take the money limit instead.
3. Round down to the cent, once, as the last step.

## Worked cases (hypothetical goodwill bases; an illustrative 12 percent limit and USD 50.00 money limit)

| Goodwill base | 12 percent of the base | After the money limit | Rounded down to the cent |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 400.00 | USD 48.00 | USD 48.00 | USD 48.00 |
| USD 458.33 | USD 54.9996 | USD 50.00 | USD 50.00 |
| USD 401.99 | USD 48.2388 | USD 48.2388 | USD 48.23 |

## Wrong reading and correct basis

| Wrong reading | Correct basis |
|---|---|
| "Round to the nearest cent." | Round down to the cent; USD 48.2388 becomes USD 48.23, and USD 48.2399 would also become USD 48.23. |
| "Round the base first, then apply the percentage." | Only the final figure is rounded. |
